product_wide_rationale: Names when the main checkout may run a worktree retirement operation, which every Domain that reclaims a worktree relies on, so it binds Product-wide rather than owning a runtime Domain.
summary: The main-checkout admission for the worktree retirement operations rests on the per-row tier gates, not on terminality: the terminal tier retires a merged tree and the unstarted tier retires a clean tree with zero commits beyond the default ref, and per-row eligibility admits no other class. worktree_audit_reclaim resolves from the main checkout beside worktree_reclaim, the allowlist map is renamed to state that ground, and the direct reclaim keeps its planner-side terminality condition. Amends CD-0105 D4 at its rationale.
title: The main-checkout admission follows the reclaim tiers
